This plot is very small, so I will not put my cash into chemical fertilizer for it this season. I own the land, so I will use manure from around the house and crop waste, and I will plant the cassava or yam material I know already, not chase new seed I have not seen well in nearby farms. I will weed it with family labor, and because this is North Central rainfed farming for me, I will not irrigate and I will not pay for outside labor on this plot.
